verdict.rationale: Otter documents automations such as auto-joining meetings, pushing action items to JIRA, Asana and CRMs, and an API with webhooks. Nothing in the pack shows versioning, review or rollback of those automations. The account-activity audit trails and logs are an adjacent compliance feature, not automation version control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
